NKJV.1: “For behold, in those days and at that time, When I bring back the captives of Judah and Jerusalem,
NKJV.2: I will also gather all nations, And bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; And I will enter into judgment with them there On account of My people, My heritage Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations; They have also divided up My land.
NKJV.3: They have cast lots for My people, Have given a boy as payment for a harlot, And sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
NKJV.4: “Indeed, what have you to do with Me,  O Tyre and Sidon, and all the coasts of Philistia? Will you retaliate against Me? But if you retaliate against Me, Swiftly and speedily I will return your retaliation upon your own head;
NKJV.5: Because you have taken My silver and My gold, And have carried into your temples My prized possessions.
NKJV.6: Also the people of Judah and the people of Jerusalem You have sold to the Greeks, That you may remove them far from their borders.
NKJV.7: “Behold, I will raise them Out of the place to which you have sold them, And will return your retaliation upon your own head.
NKJV.8: I will sell your sons and your daughters Into the hand of the people of Judah, And they will sell them to the Sabeans, To a people far off; For the LORD has spoken.”
NKJV.9: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Wake up the mighty men, Let all the men of war draw near, Let them come up.
NKJV.10: Beat your plowshares into swords And your pruning hooks into spears; Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’ ”
NKJV.11: Assemble and come, all you nations, And gather together all around. Cause Your mighty ones to go down there, O LORD.
NKJV.12: “Let the nations be wakened, and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; For there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
NKJV.13: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, go down; For the winepress is full, The vats overflow— For their wickedness is great.”
NKJV.14: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
NKJV.15: The sun and moon will grow dark, And the stars will diminish their brightness.
NKJV.16: The LORD also will roar from Zion, And utter His voice from Jerusalem; The heavens and earth will shake;  But the LORD will be a shelter for His people, And the strength of the children of Israel.
NKJV.17: “So you shall know that I am the LORD your God, Dwelling in Zion My holy mountain. Then Jerusalem shall be holy, And no aliens shall ever pass through her again.”
NKJV.18: And it will come to pass in that day That the mountains shall drip with new wine, The hills shall flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah shall be flooded with water; A fountain shall flow from the house of the LORD And water the Valley of Acacias.
NKJV.19: “Egypt shall be a desolation, And Edom a desolate wilderness, Because of violence against the people of Judah, For they have shed innocent blood in their land.
NKJV.20: But Judah shall abide forever, And Jerusalem from generation to generation.
NKJV.21: For I will acquit them of the guilt of bloodshed, whom I had not acquitted; For the LORD dwells in Zion.”

ESV.1: “For behold, in those days and at that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
ESV.2: I will gather all the nations and bring them down to the Valley of Jehoshaphat. And I will enter into judgment with them there, on behalf of my people and my heritage Israel, because they have scattered them among the nations and have divided up my land,
ESV.3: and have cast lots for my people, and have traded a boy for a prostitute, and have sold a girl for wine and have drunk it.
ESV.4: “What are you to me, O Tyre and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Are you paying me back for something? If you are paying me back, I will return your payment on your own head swiftly and speedily.
ESV.5: For you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my rich treasures into your temples.
ESV.6: You have sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks in order to remove them far from their own border.
ESV.7: Behold, I will stir them up from the place to which you have sold them, and I will return your payment on your own head.
ESV.8: I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, to a nation far away, for the LORD has spoken.”
ESV.9: Proclaim this among the nations: Consecrate for war;  stir up the mighty men. Let all the men of war draw near; let them come up.
ESV.10: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears; let the weak say, “I am a warrior.”
ESV.11: Hasten and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves there. Bring down your warriors, O LORD.
ESV.12: Let the nations stir themselves up and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat; for there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
ESV.13: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Go in, tread, for the winepress is full. The vats overflow, for their evil is great.
ESV.14: Multitudes, multitudes, in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
ESV.15: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
ESV.16: The LORD roars from Zion, and utters his voice from Jerusalem, and the heavens and the earth quake. But the LORD is a refuge to his people, a stronghold to the people of Israel.
ESV.17: “So you shall know that I am the LORD your God, who dwells in Zion, my holy mountain. And Jerusalem shall be holy, and strangers shall never again pass through it.
ESV.18: “And in that day the mountains shall drip sweet wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the streambeds of Judah shall flow with water; and a fountain shall come forth from the house of the LORD and water the Valley of Shittim.
ESV.19: “Egypt shall become a desolation and Edom a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the people of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
ESV.20: But Judah shall be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem to all generations.
ESV.21: I will avenge their blood, blood I have not avenged,  for the LORD dwells in Zion.”

NASB.1: 'For behold, in those days and at that time, When I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
NASB.2: I will gather all the nations And bring them down to the valley of Jehoshaphat. Then I will enter into judgment with them there On behalf of My people and My inheritance, Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations; And they have divided up My land.
NASB.3: 'They have also cast lots for My people, Traded a boy for a harlot And sold a girl for wine that they may drink.
NASB.4: 'Moreover, what are you to Me, O Tyre, Sidon and all the regions of Philistia? Are you rendering Me a recompense? But if you do recompense Me, swiftly and speedily I will return your recompense on your head.
NASB.5: 'Since you have taken My silver and My gold, brought My precious treasures to your temples,
NASB.6: and sold the sons of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks in order to remove them far from their territory,
NASB.7: behold, I am going to arouse them from the place where you have sold them, and return your recompense on your head.
NASB.8: 'Also I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the sons of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, to a distant nation,' for the LORD has spoken.
NASB.9: Proclaim this among the nations: Prepare a war; rouse the mighty men! Let all the soldiers draw near, let them come up!
NASB.10: Beat your plowshares into swords And your pruning hooks into spears; Let the weak say, 'I am a mighty man.'
NASB.11: Hasten and come, all you surrounding nations, And gather yourselves there. Bring down, O LORD, Your mighty ones.
NASB.12: Let the nations be aroused And come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat, For there I will sit to judge All the surrounding nations.
NASB.13: Put in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full; The vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.
NASB.14: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
NASB.15: The sun and moon grow dark And the stars lose their brightness.
NASB.16: The LORD roars from Zion And utters His voice from Jerusalem, And the heavens and the earth tremble. But the LORD is a refuge for His people And a stronghold to the sons of Israel.
NASB.17: Then you will know that I am the LORD your God, Dwelling in Zion, My holy mountain. So Jerusalem will be holy, And strangers will pass through it no more.
NASB.18: And in that day The mountains will drip with sweet wine, And the hills will flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah will flow with water; And a spring will go out from the house of the LORD To water the valley of Shittim.
NASB.19: Egypt will become a waste, And Edom will become a desolate wilderness, Because of the violence done to the sons of Judah, In whose land they have shed innocent blood.
NASB.20: But Judah will be inhabited forever And Jerusalem for all generations.
NASB.21: And I will avenge their blood which I have not avenged, For the LORD dwells in Zion.

WEB.1: “For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I restore the fortunes of Judah and Jerusalem,
WEB.2: I will gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and I will execute judgment on them there for my people, and for my heritage, Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations. They have divided my land,
WEB.3: and have cast lots for my people, and have given a boy for a prostitute, and sold a girl for wine, that they may drink.
WEB.4: “Yes, and what are you to me, Tyre, and Sidon, and all the regions of Philistia? Will you repay me? And if you repay me, I will swiftly and speedily return your repayment on your own head.
WEB.5: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried my finest treasures into your temples,
WEB.6: and have sold the children of Judah and the children of Jerusalem to the sons of the Greeks, that you may remove them far from their border.
WEB.7: Behold, I will stir them up out of the place where you have sold them, and will return your repayment on your own head;
WEB.8: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Judah, and they will sell them to the men of Sheba, to a faraway nation, for Yahweh has spoken it.”
WEB.9: Proclaim this among the nations: “Prepare for war! Stir up the mighty men. Let all the warriors draw near. Let them come up.
WEB.10: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruning hooks into spears. Let the weak say, ‘I am strong.’
WEB.11: Hurry and come, all you surrounding nations, and gather yourselves together.” Cause your mighty ones to come down there, Yahweh.
WEB.12: “Let the nations arouse themselves, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat; for there will I sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
WEB.13: Put in the sickle; for the harvest is ripe. Come, tread, for the wine press is full, the vats overflow, for their wickedness is great.”
WEB.14: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of Yahweh is near, in the valley of decision.
WEB.15: The sun and the moon are darkened, and the stars withdraw their shining.
WEB.16: Yahweh will roar from Zion, and thunder from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth will shake; but Yahweh will be a refuge to his people, and a stronghold to the children of Israel.
WEB.17: “So you will know that I am Yahweh, your God, dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain. Then Jerusalem will be holy, and no strangers will pass through her any more.
WEB.18: It will happen in that day, that the mountains will drop down sweet wine, the hills will flow with milk, all the brooks of Judah will flow with waters, and a fountain will flow out from Yahweh’s house, and will water the valley of Shittim.
WEB.19: Egypt will be a desolation, and Edom will be a desolate wilderness, for the violence done to the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
WEB.20: But Judah will be inhabited forever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
WEB.21: I will cleanse their blood, that I have not cleansed: for Yahweh dwells in Zion.”

NLT.1:
“At the time of those events,” says the LORD,
“when I restore the prosperity of Judah and Jerusalem,
NLT.2:
I will gather the armies of the world
into the valley of Jehoshaphat.
There I will judge them
for harming my people, my special possession,
for scattering my people among the nations,
and for dividing up my land.
NLT.3:
They threw dice to decide which of my people
would be their slaves.
They traded boys to obtain prostitutes
and sold girls for enough wine to get drunk.
NLT.4: “What do you have against me, Tyre and Sidon and you cities of Philistia? Are you trying to take revenge on me? If you are, then watch out! I will strike swiftly and pay you back for everything you have done.
NLT.5: You have taken my silver and gold and all my precious treasures, and have carried them off to your pagan temples.
NLT.6: You have sold the people of Judah and Jerusalem to the Greeks, so they could take them far from their homeland.
NLT.7: “But I will bring them back from all the places to which you sold them, and I will pay you back for everything you have done.
NLT.8: I will sell your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the people of Arabia, a nation far away. I, the LORD, have spoken!”
NLT.9:
Say to the nations far and wide:
“Get ready for war!
Call out your best warriors.
Let all your fighting men advance for the attack.
NLT.10:
Hammer your plowshares into swords
and your pruning hooks into spears.
Train even your weaklings to be warriors.
NLT.11:
Come quickly, all you nations everywhere.
Gather together in the valley.”
And now, O LORD, call out your warriors!
NLT.12:
“Let the nations be called to arms.
Let them march to the valley of Jehoshaphat.
There I, the LORD, will sit
to pronounce judgment on them all.
NLT.13:
Swing the sickle,
for the harvest is ripe.
Come, tread the grapes,
for the winepress is full.
The storage vats are overflowing
with the wickedness of these people.”
NLT.14:
Thousands upon thousands are waiting in the valley of decision.
There the day of the LORD will soon arrive.
NLT.15:
The sun and moon will grow dark,
and the stars will no longer shine.
NLT.16:
The LORD’s voice will roar from Zion
and thunder from Jerusalem,
and the heavens and the earth will shake.
But the LORD will be a refuge for his people,
a strong fortress for the people of Israel.
NLT.17:
“Then you will know that I, the LORD your God,
live in Zion, my holy mountain.
Jerusalem will be holy forever,
and foreign armies will never conquer her again.
NLT.18:
In that day the mountains will drip with sweet wine,
and the hills will flow with milk.
Water will fill the streambeds of Judah,
and a fountain will burst forth from the LORD’s Temple,
watering the arid valley of acacias.
NLT.19:
But Egypt will become a wasteland
and Edom will become a wilderness,
because they attacked the people of Judah
and killed innocent people in their land.
NLT.20:
“But Judah will be filled with people forever,
and Jerusalem will endure through all generations.
NLT.21:
I will pardon my people’s crimes,
which I have not yet pardoned;
and I, the LORD, will make my home
in Jerusalem with my people.”

AMP.17:
Then you will know and understand fully that I am the LORD your God,
